reserve.e: We reserve the right to make modifications.

residential.d: A trip during which people temporarily live together.
residential.e: They live in a residential neighborhood.

resolve.e: It took all my resolve to go through with the surgery.

resource.d: Something that one uses to achieve an objective, e.g. raw materials or personnel.

respond.e: to respond to a question or an argument

responsibility.d: The state of being responsible, accountable, or answerable.

responsible.d: The individual who bears the responsibility for something.
responsible.e: Parents are responsible for their child's behaviour.

rest.d: Relief from work or activity by sleeping; sleep.
rest.e: I need to get a good rest tonight; I was up late last night.

restore.d: The act of recovering data or a system from a backup.
restore.e: We backed up the data successfully, but the restore failed.

restrict.d: To restrain within boundaries; to limit; to confine
restrict.e: After suffering diahrroea, the patient was restricted to a diet of rice, cold meat, and yoghurt.

retail.d: The sale of goods directly to the consumer, encompassing the storefronts, mail-order, websites, etc., and the corporate mechanisms, branding, advertising, etc. that support them.

retain.d: To keep in possession or use.

ridiculous.e: It's ridiculous to charge so much for a little souvenir.

ripe.d: A fruit or vegetable which has ripened.

rise.d: To move, or appear to move, physically upwards relative to the ground.

risk.d: The probability of a negative outcome to a decision or event.
risk.e: There is risk of being brutalized, arrested, imprisoned and tortured, all because I want you to know the truth about this matter.

robot.d: A machine built to carry out some complex task or group of tasks by physically moving, especially one which can be programmed.

rolling.d: To cause to revolve by turning over and over; to move by turning on an axis; to impel forward by causing to turn over and over on a supporting surface.
rolling.e: To roll a wheel, a ball, or a barrel.

rotten.d: Of perishable items, overridden with bacteria and other infectious agents.
rotten.e: If you leave a bin unattended for a few weeks, the rubbish inside will turn rotten.

rubber.d: Pliable material derived from the sap of the rubber tree; a hydrocarbon biopolymer of isoprene.

rubbish.e: The rubbish is collected every Thursday in Gloucester, but on Wednesdays in Cheltenham.

runaway.d: A person or animal that runs away or has run away; a person, animal, or organization that escapes captivity or restrictions.

runway.d: A defined, narrow section of land or an artificial structure used for access.

sacred.d: Characterized by solemn religious ceremony or religious use, especially, in a positive sense; consecrated, made holy.

safari.d: A trip into any undeveloped area to see, photograph or to hunt wild animals in their own environment.
safari.e: We're going on a safari in Kenya.

safeguard.d: Something that serves as a guard or protection; a defense.
safeguard.e: Getting a flu shot is a good safeguard against illness.

safely.d: In a safe manner; without risk; using caution above all else.

safety.d: The condition or feeling of being safe; security; certainty.
safety.e: If you push it to the limit, safety is not guaranteed.

salesman.d: A man whose job it is to sell things, either in a shop / store or elsewhere.

salmon.d: One of several species of fish, typically of the Salmoninae subfamily, brownish above with silvery sides and delicate pinkish-orange flesh; they ascend rivers to spawn.

sand.d: Rock that is ground more finely than gravel, but is not as fine as silt (more formally, see grain sizes chart), forming beaches and deserts and also used in construction.
sand.e: The Canadian tar sands are a promising source of oil.

satellite.d: A moon or other smaller body orbiting a larger one.
satellite.e: A spent upper stage is a derelict satellite.

satisfaction.d: A fulfilment of a need or desire.
satisfaction.e: He enjoyed the dish with great satisfaction. He'll order it again the next time he arrives.

saucer.d: A small shallow dish to hold a cup and catch drips.
saucer.e: The saucer-shaped object could have been a UFO.

scatter.d: The act of scattering or dispersing.

scope.d: The breadth, depth or reach of a subject; a domain.
scope.e: The surgeon will scope the football player's knee to repair damage to a ligament.

score.d: The total number of goals, points, runs, etc. earned by a participant in a game.
score.e: The player with the highest score is the winner.

sculpture.d: A three dimensional work of art created by shaping malleable objects and letting them harden or by chipping away pieces from a rock (sculpting).

secure.d: To make safe; to relieve from apprehensions of, or exposure to, danger; to guard; to protect.
secure.e: to secure a creditor against loss; to secure a debt by a mortgage

security.d: The condition of not being threatened, especially physically, psychologically, emotionally, or financially.

select.d: To choose one or more elements of a set, especially a set of options.
select.e: Only a select few were allowed into the premiere.

sequence.d: A set of things next to each other in a set order; a series
sequence.e: Complete the listed tasks in sequence.

series.d: A number of things that follow on one after the other or are connected one after the other.
series.e: A series of seemingly inconsequential events led cumulatively to the fall of the company.

serious.d: Without humor or expression of happiness; grave in manner or disposition
serious.e: It was a surprise to see the captain, who had always seemed so serious, laugh so heartily.

server.d: A program that provides services to other programs or devices, either in the same computer or over a computer network.

service.d: An act of being of assistance to someone.
service.e: I say I did him a service by ending our relationship – now he can freely pursue his career.

session.d: An informal gathering of musicians to play music, especially improvised jazz or a similar genre.
session.e: "Are we having a recording session?" / "Yes. We've even got some session musicians to provide some brass."

shallow.d: A shallow portion of an otherwise deep body of water.
shallow.e: The ship ran aground in an unexpected shallow.

sharp.d: The symbol ♯, placed after the name of a note in the key signature or before a note on the staff to indicate that the note is to be played a semitone higher.
sharp.e: The pitch pipe sounded out a perfect F♯ (F sharp).

shave.d: To make (the head, skin etc.) bald or (the hair) shorter by using a tool such as a razor or electric clippers to cut the hair close to the skin.
shave.e: I instructed the barber to give me a shave.

sheer.e: Her light, sheer dress caught everyone’s attention.

shelter.d: A refuge, haven or other cover or protection from something.
shelter.e: During the rainstorm, we sheltered under a tree.

sheriff.d: (High Sheriff) An official of a shire or county office, responsible for carrying out court orders, law enforcement and other duties.

shift.d: A modifier key whose main function is shifting between two or more functions of any of certain other keys (usually by pressing Shift and the other button simultaneously).
shift.e: Just last week she bought a new shift at the market.

shortage.d: A lack or deficiency; an insufficient amount.

shrimp.d: Any of many swimming, often edible crustaceans, chiefly of the infraorder Caridea or the suborder Dendrobranchiata, with slender legs, long whiskers and a long abdomen.

sickness.d: The quality or state of being sick or diseased; illness; an illness.

sidewalk.d: A paved footpath located at the side of a road, for the use of pedestrians.

sigh.d: To inhale a larger quantity of air than usual, and immediately expel it; to make a deep single audible respiration, especially as the result or involuntary expression of fatigue, exhaustion, grief, sorrow, frustration, or the like.
sigh.e: Sigh, I'm so bored at work today.

signal.d: A sequence of states representing an encoded message in a communication channel.
signal.e: a signal exploit; a signal service; a signal act of benevolence

signature.d: A person's name, written by that person, used as identification or to signify approval of accompanying material, such as a legal contract.
signature.e: Rabbit in mustard sauce is my signature dish.

significance.d: The extent to which something matters; importance
significance.e: As a juror your opinion is of great significance for the outcome of the trial.

signpost.d: A post bearing a sign that gives information on directions.
signpost.e: The route wasn't signposted, and we got lost on the way.

silent.d: Free from sound or noise; absolutely still; perfectly quiet.

silk.d: A fine fiber excreted by the silkworm or other arthropod (such as a spider).
silk.e: The thread made of silk was barely visible.

similarity.d: Closeness of appearance to something else.

similarly.d: In a like style or manner.

simplify.d: To make simpler, either by reducing in complexity, reducing to component parts, or making easier to understand.

skeleton.d: The system that provides support to an organism, internal and made up of bones and cartilage in vertebrates, external in some other animals.
skeleton.e: She dressed up as a skeleton for Halloween.

skin.d: The outer protective layer of the body of any animal, including of a human.
skin.e: He is so disgusting he makes my skin crawl.

skyscraper.d: A very tall building with a large number of floors.

slavery.d: An institution or social practice of owning human beings as property, especially for use as forced laborers.

sleeve.d: The part of a garment that covers the arm.
sleeve.e: This bearing requires a sleeve so the shaft will fit snugly.

slight.d: The act of slighting; a deliberate act of neglect or discourtesy.

slightly.e: He was slightly built, but tall.

slip.d: To lose one’s traction on a slippery surface; to slide due to a lack of friction.
slip.e: I had a slip on the ice and bruised my hip.

slogan.d: A distinctive phrase of a person or group of people (such as a movement or political party); a motto.

slot.d: A narrow depression, perforation, or aperture; especially, one for the reception of a piece fitting or sliding into it.
slot.e: insert tab A into slot B
